Your employer in your workplace has withheld your earned salary for two months. Under Indian law, withholding earned wages for service already rendered is unlawful.

* **Payment of Wages Act, 1936 (Section 5):** Employers are legally required to disburse earned wages within 7 to 10 days of the wage period.
